answer: The mirror schedule is applied in copper and timber shows each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 37% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4839 identities would post 2848 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
